about.what: Training-label sweep for formulation B; every arm scored against TRUE_MAX (observed max).
about.protocol: Data.load(); one row per catalyst; 66 composition columns (prep_enc + 65 element loadings; 34 vary across the 917 catalysts); catalyst_folds 5-fold; TUNED LightGBM (grouped_tuning.json), n_jobs=2; train-fold StandardScaler
about.n_jobs_note: phase8 used the lgb_params default n_jobs=-1; R1 reproduces phase8 exactly with n_jobs=2, so it has no effect here

estimators.per_seed_mean: metric on each seed's out-of-fold predictions, then mean over seeds
estimators.seed_averaged_predictions: out-of-fold predictions averaged over seeds, then the metric
estimators.bootstrap: paired catalyst bootstrap on seed-averaged predictions (ocm_eval.paired_catalyst_bootstrap)

about.truth: TRUE_MAX = observed max over all the catalyst's rows, for every arm

label_definitions.q0.00: cell minimum, then max over temperatures
label_definitions.q0.50: ADOPTED: cell median, then max over temperatures
label_definitions.nearest_rank_upper_quartile: ceil(0.25 n)-th largest row per cell, then max
label_definitions.median_of_all_raw_rows: median over all rows, no cells
label_definitions.five_row_unfair: five identical-feature rows per catalyst (labels q0.00..q1.00), TUNED min_child_samples=20 rows

phase8_reproduction_R1.estimator: per_seed_spearman, spearman_mean, enrichment_mean, precision_at20_mean: per-seed out-of-fold metrics (mean over seeds); spearman_seed_averaged_predictions: on seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions; catalyst_bootstrap_*: arm - q1.00 Spearman, paired catalyst bootstrap on seed-averaged predictions, 3000 resamples, seed 7; target_mean: label mean, no model

five_row_checks_R5.note: max_abs_spread_across_five_rows is the largest spread among the five predictions of any catalyst; R5 requires exactly 0. It holds by construction (identical inputs to a fixed tree model) and checks the row stacking and reshape only; it is not evidence about labels.

five_row_unfair_vs_mean_of_five_seed_ave.estimator: on seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions; descriptive, no test

five_row_fair_vs_mean_of_five_seed_avera.estimator: on seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions; descriptive, no test

five_row_checks_R5.five_row_unfair_reading: all_917: per-seed mean Spearman 0.7584 vs q1.00 0.7606; on seed-averaged predictions 0.7707 vs 0.7672; bootstrap delta +0.0035 [-0.0102, +0.0179], no detectable change. Seed-averaging gain: five_row_unfair +0.0123, q1.00 +0.0065 (the gain is not specific to this arm; see seed_averaging_gain). Seed spread (median across-seed SD of catalyst predictions; mean pairwise seed Spearman): five_row_unfair 0.571 yield-%, 0.958; mean_of_five 0.343 yield-%, 0.982; five_row_fair 0.348 yield-%, 0.982. Its predictions vary more between seeds than those of mean_of_five and five_row_fair, consistent with a less regularised model.

seed_spread.what: all_917; median over catalysts of the across-seed SD (ddof=1) of the out-of-fold prediction (yield %), and mean Spearman between the out-of-fold predictions of every pair of seeds; descriptive, not a test of any difference

cell_ratio6_share.population: all observed (catalyst, temperature) cells, conditions file; no model

within_cell_check.population: cells with at least one CH4:O2 = 2 row and one CH4:O2 = 6 row

cell_ratio6_share.note: A complete 27-condition cell holds exactly 1/3 CH4:O2 = 6 rows. The share moves only when rows were excluded by the mass-balance check (or duplicated in a doubled catalyst). This is an across-cell association. It mixes catalysts, so it shows that the cell median tracks the surviving condition mix, not that exclusion alone moves it.

peak_ratio.population: all_917; single highest row per catalyst (first in file order if tied); no model
peak_ratio.note: CH4:O2 = 2 is the lowest (most O2-rich) ratio tested, the edge of the 2/4/6 grid.

single_highest_row_influence.population: catalysts with >= 2 rows (913 of 917); no model
single_highest_row_influence.what: drop each catalyst's single highest row, rebuild the label, compare. Absolute change in yield %; relative = change / label (label > 0).

seed_averaging_gain.what: all_917; seed-averaged Spearman minus per-seed mean Spearman, per arm; descriptive

delta_vs_n_seeds_averaged.what: all_917; Spearman(seed-averaged prediction over the first k seeds of [0, 1, 2, 7, 13]) minus the same for q1.00; point delta, descriptive, no test

audit_comparison.note: Approximate values from an uncommitted ad hoc analysis. Its seeds and estimators are not recorded. Each entry names the quantity this script compares it to.

global_min_delta_vs_max_seedmean.this_script_quantity: all_917, difference of per-seed mean Spearman, global_min - q1.00

enrichment_range_q050_to_q100_low.this_script_quantity: all_917, per-seed mean enrichment, min over q0.50/q0.75/q1.00 (this sweep)

enrichment_range_q050_to_q100_high.this_script_quantity: all_917, per-seed mean enrichment, max over q0.50/q0.75/q1.00 (this sweep)

audit_comparison.enrichment_range_explanation: The audit range matches phase8_target_robustness.json across its 9 quantiles q0.50-q1.00 (per-seed mean enrichment 4.152x at q0.95 to 4.435x at q0.80). This sweep keeps only q0.50, q0.75 and q1.00 from that range, so its range is narrower. Same runs, different subset.

two_seed_bootstrap_mean_of_five_vs_q1.00.this_script_quantity: all_917, bootstrap-mean delta Spearman on predictions averaged over seeds 0 and 1 only

two_seed_bootstrap_q0.75_vs_q1.00.this_script_quantity: all_917, bootstrap-mean delta Spearman on predictions averaged over seeds 0 and 1 only

two_seed_bootstrap_q0.50_vs_q1.00.this_script_quantity: all_917, bootstrap-mean delta Spearman on predictions averaged over seeds 0 and 1 only

two_seed_bootstrap_global_min_vs_q1.00.this_script_quantity: all_917, bootstrap-mean delta Spearman on predictions averaged over seeds 0 and 1 only

audit_comparison.two_seed_explanation: Averaging seeds 0 and 1 only reproduces the audit's 2-seed bootstrap deltas (all_917 Spearman, arm - q1.00) for mean_of_five, q0.75 and q0.50 to within 0.0003. For global_min it gives -0.0901 vs the audit's -0.0907 (off by 0.0006; see global_min_explanation). The remainder is not explained here; the audit's seeds and resampling are not recorded. The q0.50 - q1.00 point delta changes with the number of seeds averaged: 1 seed +0.0114, 2 seeds +0.0082, 5 seeds +0.0049. Seed-averaging over all seeds raises q1.00 by +0.0065 and q0.50 by +0.0055. The committed result is the 5-seed one. 2-seed q0.50 CI lower bound: audit -0.0001, this script +0.0002.
audit_comparison.global_min_explanation: Candidates for the audit's -0.0907 (all_917, global_min - q1.00 Spearman): two_seed_bootstrap_delta -0.0901, five_seed_bootstrap_delta -0.0933, difference_of_per_seed_means -0.1033. Closest: two_seed_bootstrap_delta. The 5-seed bootstrap CI [-0.1188, -0.0685] is entirely below zero: detected loss.

verdict.adopted_label: q0.50 (per-cell median, then max over temperatures)
verdict.reason: not set by a single high reading (in the 913 of 917 catalysts with >= 2 rows, dropping each catalyst's single highest row moves the q0.50 label by a median 0.01 yield-% and the observed max by 0.38); ranks at least as well as the observed max in the sense of rule R4: no 95% CI of q0.50 - q1.00 lies entirely below zero (2 metrics x 3 populations). This is a no-detectable-loss claim, not a superiority claim. all_917, seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions, bootstrap-mean delta [95% CI]: Spearman +0.0049 [-0.0021, +0.0120], no detectable change; point delta +0.0049 favours q0.50; a loss of up to 0.0021 is not excluded. Enrichment@10% -0.17x [-0.76, +0.43], no detectable change; point delta -0.22x favours q1.00; a loss of up to 0.76x is not excluded.

reading_limits.not_superiority: q0.50 is detectably better than q1.00 on: none of the 6 comparisons. Labels detectably better than q1.00 (CI entirely above zero; bootstrap-mean delta [95% CI]): q0.75 all_917 spearman +0.0063 [+0.0007, +0.0122]; q0.75 EE_771 spearman +0.0087 [+0.0010, +0.0162]; q0.75 ND_889 spearman +0.0070 [+0.0015, +0.0126]; nearest_rank_upper_quartile all_917 spearman +0.0061 [+0.0005, +0.0119]; nearest_rank_upper_quartile EE_771 spearman +0.0086 [+0.0009, +0.0159]; nearest_rank_upper_quartile ND_889 spearman +0.0068 [+0.0014, +0.0126]; mean_of_five EE_771 spearman +0.0088 [+0.0011, +0.0166]; five_row_fair EE_771 spearman +0.0088 [+0.0007, +0.0170]. Documents must not turn the adopted-label verdict into a superiority claim.
reading_limits.enrichment_estimator_note: all_917 enrichment@10%, q0.50 vs q1.00, depends on the estimator: per-seed mean 4.261x vs 4.283x (-0.022x; equal to phase8's stored enrichment_mean values, checked by R1); seed-averaged predictions 4.130x vs 4.348x (point delta -0.217x); bootstrap-mean delta -0.165x. Quote one estimator at a time and name it.
reading_limits.multiplicity: This file holds 118 distinct paired-bootstrap 95% CIs (q1.00 - q0.50 counted once, as q0.50 - q1.00; the 2-seed audit CIs included); 26 read 'detected'. At 95% per CI some detections are expected by chance. 12 readings sit near the zero boundary (rule W2, listed in boundary_readings); do not over-read them. The q0.50 - q1.00 all_917 Spearman reading is 'detected' with seeds 0 and 1 averaged and 'no detectable change' with all 5 seeds.
reading_limits.boundary_rule: W2: CI bound nearer zero is closer to zero than 10% of the CI width

sensitivity_table.what: every label minus q1.00 (observed max) and minus q0.50 (adopted), per population and metric; paired catalyst bootstrap on seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions, 3000 resamples, seed 7; delta_boot_mean = bootstrap mean (phase8 convention), delta_point = full-population difference

cautions: 84.5% of catalysts (775/917) have their single highest row at CH4:O2 = 2, the edge of the tested grid. The true optimum may lie outside it, so every label here is a within-grid quantity.

The cell median shifts with which conditions survived the mass-balance check: across 4399 observed cells, Spearman(share of CH4:O2 = 6 rows, cell median) = -0.249. This is an across-cell association that mixes catalysts. Within the 3812 cells holding both ratios, the CH4:O2 = 6 median lies below the CH4:O2 = 2 median in 81% of them, so a cell that lost CH4:O2 = 2 rows tends to have a lower median. The cell max shows about the same association (-0.248), so this caution applies to the observed max as well and is not a reason to prefer the max over the median.
verdict.supersedes: phase8_target_robustness.json verdict 'KEEP the observed maximum' -- the PI adopted the median; the evidence permits either
verdict.supersedes_basis: rule R6; q0.50 - q1.00, seed-averaged out-of-fold predictions, bootstrap-mean delta [95% CI]: all_917 spearman +0.0049 [-0.0021, +0.0120], no detectable change; all_917 enrichment -0.17 [-0.76, +0.43], no detectable change; EE_771 spearman +0.0090 [-0.00003, +0.0181], no detectable change; EE_771 enrichment +0.07 [-0.65, +0.91], no detectable change; ND_889 spearman +0.0049 [-0.0018, +0.0119], no detectable change; ND_889 enrichment -0.22 [-0.90, +0.45], no detectable change. None of the six CIs excludes zero.
